doc: The codes plugin-qualify's scan refuses a plugin by, each with its source sentence in English and the args it names (omx-contract's codes shape; translations are not here). Each language's sentences are in catalogs/<lang>.json, keyed by the code. tools/descriptors.py renders the English sentence from this file; no module repeats it. A code is never reworded.

text.en: Two ports of this plugin share the symbol {symbol}, so neither can be addressed by it; the plugin is not described.
